source: https://visa.immigration.go.tz/start HTML and https://visa.immigration.go.tz/guidelines, read 2026-08-30. The public start screen exposes five required fields, exact data-val messages and 100-character limits for email and security answer. Later screens were not opened because that would create a live application. No passport regex or later-screen limits are claimed, and no local validator is mounted.

passport_route.label: Passport route
passport_route.help: Read the current exemption and referral lists for the passport before starting. Referral cases must apply online and wait for approval.

visa_type.label: Visa type
visa_type.help: Tourists normally use Ordinary Visa, except United States passport holders who use Multiple Visa. Transit Visa is only for onward transit.

email.label: Email
email.help: The portal sends the application ID and decision to this address.

errors.invalidFormat: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.tooLong: The field Email must be a string with a maximum length of 100.

passport_number.label: Passport Number
passport_number.placeholder: As shown on the bio page
passport_number.help: The public first step requires the passport number but publishes no pattern or length.

errors.required: The Passport Number field is required.

passport_issue_country.label: Passport Issue Country
passport_issue_country.help: Choose the country that issued the passport used for this application.

errors.required: The Passport Issue Country field is required.

security_question.label: Security Question
security_question.help: This is part of the application-recovery information on the public start screen.

security_answer.label: Security Answer
security_answer.help: Store the answer with the application ID. The official HTML sets a 100-character maximum.

errors.tooLong: The field Security Answer must be a string with a maximum length of 100.

passport_validity.label: Passport validity and blank page
passport_validity.placeholder: At least 6 months and one unused visa page
passport_validity.help: The guidelines require at least six months of passport validity and at least one unused visa page before application.

photo.label: Visa photo
photo.placeholder: JPG or JPEG, up to 500 KB
photo.help: The guidelines require a colour full-face image on a plain background, no larger than 45 mm by 35 mm and 500 KB, in JPG or JPEG format.

travel_document.label: Return or onward travel document
travel_document.placeholder: Return ticket or transit onward ticket
travel_document.help: Ordinary Visa applicants need a return ticket. Transit applicants need an entry visa and/or onward ticket for the destination country.
